transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy work or lifting for a month.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I have noticed that I am very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some sensitivity to light can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is also red and painful, is not normal and may need checking.  

Do you have any other questions?
